name: JustBacked API
description: Jobs at venture-backed startups that raised in the last six months, plus the member's application tracker, company lists and saved searches. Members only: create a key at https://justbacked.com/account#api. 1,000 requests per day per member (UTC). JustBacked never submits job applications; the application-form endpoint is read-only.
